in_sanskrit.name: Ajajul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Invincible, Unconquerable
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajajul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ajajul is derived from Sanskrit 'aj' (invincible, unconquerable) and 'ajul' (unwavering, unyielding). This name is associated with the Hindu god Indra, the king of heaven, who is known for his strength, power, and unwavering determination. Ajajul is a powerful name that represents courage, determination, and the ability to overcome any obstacle.
